# algosec_devices (Data Source)

Administrator-visible device inventory. Only allowlisted non-secret fields are retained; device credentials are discarded.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "algosec_devices" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) Complete returned inventory, deterministically ordered. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `id` (String) Lookup identity.

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `baseline_profile` (String) Baseline profile.
- `brand` (String) Brand.
- `brand_name` (String) Brand name.
- `collector` (String) Collector.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `host_name` (String) Host name.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `node_type` (String) Node type.
- `original_name` (String) Original name.
